{{Quote|Honestly, who's going to target a science museum? Besides, the general's best men are guarding me.|Doctor Godera|<ref name="Firestorm" />}}
The '''Corellian Science Museum''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located in [[Axial Park]], a district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Brint]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] set up a base in the museum during the [[Battle of Corellia]], and the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientific adviser]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] maintained a [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] in the museum. However, during the conflict, the museum was attacked by Imperial forces, who [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the Republic forces stationed at the museum, including Godera.

==Description==
The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Science [[Museum/Legends|Museum]] was a building located on the northern edge of [[Axial Park]], a district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. The building's entrance hallway was in the shape of a rectangular loop, with a wall between the building's entrance and the entrance to the museum proper. The main room was dominated by the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]] of a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] from the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and the museum had at least two side rooms that branched off the main chamber. When the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] occupied the museum, one of the side rooms and part of the main room was occupied by [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] equipment for [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]]'s work.<ref name="Firestorm" />

==History==
{{Quote|Our science advisor is waiting for you. He has information on that rogue Jedi you're after.|Colonel Brint, to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Firestorm" />}}
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Empire invaded the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of Corellia and instigated the [[Battle of Corellia]]. During the later stages of the lengthy conflict, the Republic Military secured the Science Museum and established a command post there under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Brint]] of the [[Eighty-third Battalion]]. Doctor Nasan Godera, scientific [[Advisor/Legends|adviser]] to the Republic's [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]], set up a [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] there, and, on Suthra's orders, he dispatched [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to search for [[Tol Braga]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who had been corrupted by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and put to work furthering the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] plans to [[Death/Legends|kill]] thousands in order to start a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|dark-side ritual]].<ref name="Firestorm" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Godera's efforts met with success around the same [[Time/Legends|time]] the unit of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] under the leadership of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] arrived at the museum. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jol Zackin]] soon arrived at the museum to request Brint's aid in rescuing [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] Corellian citizens, but Brint and Zackin were still arguing over the subject when the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] arrived. The Knight settled the disagreement, dispatching the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] Jedi to rescue the civilians despite Brint's attempts to bribe the Knight into using the Jedi to attack Imperial medical camps. The Hero of Tython then met with Godera, who sent the Knight to take out the Empire's [[Firestorm Turbolaser]]s that Braga's [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] subordinates were setting up in buildings around Axial Park. Godera himself continued his work to locate the source of the transmissions to the Sith in those buildings in hopes of locating Braga himself.<ref name="Firestorm" />
{{Endgame}}

However, while the Jedi was gone, the Science Museum was attacked by Imperial forces. Brint was among the few survivors and contacted Suthra for aid, though by the time Suthra arrived with reinforcements and eliminated the Imperial invaders, most of the Republic forces stationed there&mdash;including Godera&mdash;had been killed in the fighting.<ref name="Firestorm" /> Suthra's forces largely abandoned the museum after the attack, moving into Coronet's [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] as the Republic continued to gain ground against the Empire.<ref name="Mutual">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Mutual Assured Destruction|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian Science Museum appears as a class-restricted phase for the Jedi Knight-class mission "Firestorm" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. When first arriving at the museum, the player is presented with an alignment choice as to how to use the player's remaining Jedi forces; as the Knight is a Republic player and is assumed to choose only [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] options, this article assumes that the player sided with Senator Zackin.<ref name="Firestorm" /> The museum was also labeled on a map of Axial Park that appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
